title: ZILFIT STL Fingerprint Registry
description: Authority registry for locked STL fingerprints. Every STL submitted for print must have a registered hash. Fingerprint mismatch or absence blocks the print gate.

edition.description: ZILFIT edition name (e.g., CALM, VITAL, FOCUS, BALANCE, FEMME)

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical STL payload

validated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of fingerprint computation and validation

validator_version.description: Version of the fingerprint contract used to compute this hash

notes: No hashes are registered yet. Fingerprints will be added after first STL export.
Fingerprint computation is handled by runtime/zilfit_fingerprint_contract.py.
The fingerprint covers vertices, triangles, bounds, and manifold_flags only.
Provenance metadata (created_at, schema_version) is excluded from the hash.
